title: Solid Color Thickened Insulated Lunch Tote Bag, Portable Thermal Cooler Lunch Bag, Reusable Waterproof Food Carrier Bag, Leakproof Lunch Container Bag For Office Workers Students Picnic Travel
body_html: Our thick insulated lunch bag adopts premium solid-color minimalist style, perfectly suited for daily meal carrying at school, office, picnic and travel. The interior is lined with food-safe aluminum foil matched with dense EPE pearl cotton, creating dual thermal protection. It features excellent temperature insulation to retain hot food warm and cold food cool, meanwhile locking food freshness well to avoid flavor loss. Equipped with sturdy hand straps for easy handheld transport, the roomy inner space can accommodate various lunch containers, fruits and beverages. The waterproof outer material resists minor spills and can be quickly wiped clean with a damp cloth. Reusable and durable, this thermal food tote is a practical daily essential for students and office staff who bring homemade lunches.
